snippet.title: Where in America's Past Is Carmen Sandiego? (Macintosh game 1992)
snippet.description:
"Where in America's Past Is Carmen Sandiego" is an educational game by Brøderbund.
As an agent of the ACME detective agency, you'll chase them across 45 locations and nine time periods in a Chronoskimmer.
